''See also: [[Imperial Steward Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Imperial]] Steward is a leadership position within the [[Aurelian Empire]], currently held by Imperial Steward Calder Marten{{!}}Calder Marten. The role serves as a caretaker and protector of the realm during an interim period, with the Steward occupying the [[throne]] until a true Emperor can be officially declared. While the position is intended to manage the empire's affairs, it is often tied to the use of the [[throne]], a device that has historically driven a previous Steward to insanity. The [[Imperial]] Steward's Authority{{!}}authority is recognized by various factions, including the [[Imperialist Guild Heads]] who facilitated [[Marten]]'s assumption of the role. The Steward carries out official duties such as delivering public addresses to the citizens in the Emperor's [[Hall of Address]] and exercising legal Authority{{!}}authority to arrest individuals. To ensure safety, the Steward often wears the [[Emperor's armor]] and a [[silver crown]]. Although the role is distinct from that of an [[Imperial Regent]], the Steward's actions and Authority{{!}}authority are central to the empire's governance and its interactions with various [[Guilds]], such as the [[Consultants]] and the [[Champions]].}}
